title: An Earlier Payment on the Enrolment and the Share of a Payment Released
content:
An enrolment on the Keyturn Host Protection Plan that has already been paid on in the last year has part of a further payment held back.

- Where a payment already stands on the enrolment in the twelve months before and a share stands unpaid on it, the payment is released at the marketplace's repeat-settlement share of 96 percent.
- Where a payment already stands in that period and nothing stands unpaid, it is released at the marketplace's settled-history share of 99 percent.
- Where no payment stands in that period, no share is taken on that account.

### Condition and result

| Payment standing in the twelve months before | Share standing unpaid | Released at |
|---|---|---|
| one or more | some | 96 percent |
| one or more | none | 99 percent |
| none | either | the whole of it |

One payment in the period is enough to reach the first two readings; the payments are not counted beyond the first.

### The record the reading is taken from

The payments counted are those released against the claims on this enrolment within the twelve months before, and what stands unpaid is the amount owed by the host on the enrolment.
